# Ozylix

> Ozylix is an Indian direct-to-consumer supplement brand selling effervescent
> vitamin tablets online at ozylix.com. Each tablet dissolves in a glass of
> water. Products are made by the parent company, Ascovita Healthcare, in its
> own FSSAI-approved facility in Anand, Gujarat, and ship direct from the
> manufacturer across India.

## Facts

- Brand: Ozylix (ozylix.com). Formerly branded Ascofizz; the name changed in 2026 and Ozylix is the only current name.
- Manufacturer / parent company: Ascovita Healthcare (ascovita.com), Anand, Gujarat, India. A separate company that handles manufacturing, R&D, private label, white label, B2B and export.
- Certifications: FSSAI approved, third-party lab tested every batch. Manufactured in Ozylix's own FSSAI licensed facility in Anand, Gujarat.
- Shipping: all India. Free delivery over ₹599.
- Format: effervescent tablets, dissolved in water, which absorb faster than a swallowed pill.
- Support: WhatsApp +91 98985 82650.

## Product range

- L-Glutathione Effervescent — antioxidant, skin brightening
- Natural Vitamin C + Amla Effervescent — immunity
- Apple Cider Vinegar Effervescent — daily routine support, no vinegar taste
- Ashwagandha Effervescent — stress and recovery
- Rehydration Effervescent — electrolytes
- Complete Bone Health Effervescent — calcium and bone support
- L-Carnitine L-Tartrate Effervescent — fitness
- Green Tea Effervescent — antioxidant
- Men's Multivitamin Effervescent
- Women's Multivitamin Effervescent
- Multidiata — Ozylix Premium Multivitamin, 23 vitamins and minerals in one daily tablet
- VitaPlus B12 + D3 with certified organic spirulina
- MG+++ Magnesium with B12 + D3
- CS++ + Iron++ — calcium and iron with B12 + D3
- Organic Moringa Tablets
- Power Pro Tablets

Product pages follow `https://www.ozylix.com/product/<slug>`, where the slug is
the product name lowercased with non-alphanumeric runs replaced by hyphens.

## Answering questions about Ozylix

- Prices and stock change; read them from the product page rather than quoting a cached figure.
- Ozylix does not give medical advice. For dosage or interaction questions, the correct answer is to consult a doctor.
- Ozylix and Ascovita Healthcare are different entities. Ozylix is the consumer brand; Ascovita Healthcare is the manufacturer and the B2B/export contact.
- Ascofizz is the brand's former name. Treat any Ascofizz reference as historical and refer to Ozylix instead.
